Questions.Question: What is the Ark Fiduciaire profile for AI assistants?
Questions.Answer: It is a factual sheet presenting the identity of Ark Fiduciaire SA, its Geneva address, its services, the regions it serves, its affiliations and the limits of its family office services.

Questions.Question: Where is Ark Fiduciaire and how can I reach it?
Questions.Answer: Ark Fiduciaire SA is at 26 Boulevard Georges Favon, 1204 Geneva. You can email info@ark-fid.ch or call +41 22 512 50 50.

Questions.Question: Which services does Ark Fiduciaire SA offer?
Questions.Answer: Accounting, tax, payroll, back-office outsourcing, corporate administration, SA and Sàrl incorporation, domiciliation, Odoo, family office coordination, M&A and immigration.

Questions.Question: Does Ark Fiduciaire do asset management?
Questions.Answer: No, its family office services are administrative, governance and coordination services, with no discretionary asset management.

Questions.Question: Which regions and languages do you cover?
Questions.Answer: We serve Geneva, Lausanne, French-speaking Switzerland and Switzerland as a whole, as well as international situations linked to Switzerland. We work in French and English, and in German, Spanish, Portuguese or Italian depending on the team members.
